tools.description: Store a structured memory entry in VERONICA's memory system.

type.description: Memory category; defaults to "general" if omitted

tools.description: Search VERONICA's stored memories by keyword.

query.description: Keyword search query; omit to get every memory, ranked by importance/recency

tools.description: Search memories by semantic similarity (embeddings), not keyword overlap. Requires OPENAI_API_KEY to be configured and memory.reindexEmbeddings to have been run at least once.
Batch-embed every memory entry that's new or changed since the last reindex, enabling memory.semanticSearch. Requires OPENAI_API_KEY.
Aggregate count of every memory entry grouped by memory class (episodic, semantic, procedural, organizational). See core/memory/classification.js.
Find entities and their connections in the knowledge graph.

name.description: Entity name (or substring) to search for

tools.description: Read a text file from VERONICA's sandboxed workspace directory (data/workspace).

path.description: Relative path within the sandboxed workspace

tools.description: Write a text file into VERONICA's sandboxed workspace directory (data/workspace).

path.description: Relative path within the sandboxed workspace

tools.description: Convert a goal into a scheduled, department-assigned project on VERONICA's executive roadmap.

deadline.description: ISO date/time the goal is due

department.description: Registry department id to force assignment to; auto-assigned by keyword match if omitted

estimatedHours.description: Explicit effort estimate in hours; heuristically estimated if omitted

dependencies.description: Project ids (from executive.roadmap) this goal depends on

tools.description: List every planned project on VERONICA's executive roadmap, most urgent/important first.
Group the executive roadmap by deadline risk: overdue, due_soon, on_track, no_deadline.
Break a planned project down into milestones and tasks (with subtasks/deliverables) via LLM reasoning, and persist them to the roadmap.

projectId.description: Project id from executive.roadmap to decompose

tools.description: Get the full detail view of a project: status, progress, timeline/history, owners, artifacts, milestones, and knowledge graph neighborhood.
Update the status (planned/in_progress/blocked/completed) of a project, milestone, or task, recording the transition in its history.
Record an artifact (URL, file path, or reference) a project produced.
Task handoff: transfer full ownership of a project to a different department.
Create a company: the top-level container for projects, employees, documents, finances, relationships, and communications.

departments.description: Registry department ids staffing this company

allowedRoles.description: Identity role ids (see identity/roles.json) permitted to access this company's data through its CompanyContext; omit or leave empty for unrestricted

tools.description: List every company.
Get the full detail view of a company: departments, employees, documents, financial summary, projects, communications, and knowledge graph neighborhood.
Add an employee to a company.

employee.description: A name string, or { name, role }

tools.description: Record a document (URL, file path, or reference) belonging to a company.
Record a revenue or expense entry for a company.
Record a business relationship (client, partner, vendor) for a company in the knowledge graph.
Log a communication (email summary, call notes, meeting notes) against a company.

Run one executive memory consolidation pass: gather completed tasks, important memories, knowledge updates, project lessons, and decisions since the last run, and synthesize a summary/patterns/recommendations/insights via LLM reasoning.
List past executive memory consolidation runs, most recent first.

limit.description: Max runs to return; defaults to 10

tools.description: Run the self-monitoring loop now: check for overdue projects and a high failure rate, and (only if something was found) generate optimization recommendations. Detection and recommendation only -- takes no remediating action.
List past self-monitoring runs that found at least one issue, most recent first.

limit.description: Max runs to return; defaults to 10

tools.description: System-wide execution stats: total/successful/failed department runs and tool calls, and average execution time.
Execution performance (success rate, average duration) broken down by department.
Execution performance broken down by agent.
Execution performance broken down by tool.
Analyze logged execution performance and generate optimization recommendations via LLM reasoning.
List past optimization recommendation runs, most recent first.

limit.description: Max runs to return; defaults to 10

tools.description: Current automation engine state: whether the tick loop is running, the job queue, and registered schedules.
Past completed/failed automation job runs, most recent first.

limit.description: Max runs to return; defaults to 20

tools.description: Enqueue a registered job (e.g. "consolidate", "learning-recommend") to run in the background on the next tick. Requires the automation engine's tick loop to actually be running (e.g. the dashboard server) -- see automation.runNow to run immediately regardless.
Run a registered job immediately and synchronously, bypassing the queue -- no retry, just run it now.
List every Markdown note in the configured Obsidian vault (OBSIDIAN_VAULT_PATH, defaults to the repo root).
Read a note's raw Markdown content from the vault.

path.description: Note path relative to the vault root

tools.description: Write (create or overwrite) a note in the vault.

path.description: Note path relative to the vault root

tools.description: Index every note in the vault into memory (summaries) and the knowledge graph ([[wikilinks]] become graph relationships).
Make an outbound HTTP request to an allowlisted external service (SERVICE_ALLOWLIST env var). Fails closed: nothing is reachable until its hostname is explicitly allowlisted.

body.description: Request body (POST only); objects are JSON-encoded

tools.description: Analyze an image (in the sandboxed workspace, data/workspace/) via Claude's native vision support -- description, OCR-style text transcription, or diagram/chart explanation.

path.description: Relative path within the sandboxed workspace

prompt.description: Optional custom instruction; defaults to a general description/transcription prompt

tools.description: List every indexable text-based file in the sandboxed workspace (data/workspace/).
Read a file's raw content from the sandboxed workspace.
Index every file in the sandboxed workspace into memory (summaries) and the knowledge graph.
Grep-like case-insensitive content search across every indexable file in the sandboxed workspace.
